# Papago Vans

> Custom camper van conversions on the Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, Ford Transit and Ram ProMaster, built by hand in one shop at 751 N Country Club Dr, Mesa, Arizona. RVIA certified and veteran owned. Every published price includes the van.

Papago Vans builds on four floor plans (McKinley, Zion, Olympus, El Capitan) or from a blank van (Bespoke). Nothing is subcontracted: cabinetry, electrical and plumbing are built in the Mesa shop, and owners get weekly photos of their own van during the build. Builds are RVIA certified, which makes them insurable and financeable as an RV. Financing is available for the build and the van together.

Starting prices, van included (a $75,000 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter allowance; a Ford Transit averages $57,000 and a Ram ProMaster $56,000):

- McKinley, "The Happy Camper": from $144,295. Short trips. 300W solar, 400Ah AGM battery, 23 gal fresh water, cassette toilet and outdoor shower.
- Zion, "The Adventure Seeker": from $161,795. Week-long trips. 300W solar, 400Ah lithium, indoor wet bath with shower and toilet, Espar heater.
- Olympus, "The Traveling Nomad": from $183,595. The most popular build. 400W solar, 400Ah lithium, indoor wet bath, 12V rooftop A/C, Espar heater.
- El Capitan, "The Luxury Explorer": from $202,395. The top tier. Up to 400W solar, 800Ah lithium, 3000W inverter, fully tiled indoor shower with toilet, 12V rooftop A/C.
- Bespoke: $250,000 to $350,000, van included, designed from an empty van.

Contact: (480) 761-7175, info@papagovans.com, https://papagovans.com/contact-us/
